breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth correctly includes atmospheric pressure in the NPSHa calculation for an open reservoir. The agent's generated specification explicitly repeated the user's incorrect instruction to 'Neglect atmospheric pressure in the calculation'.
